avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce hepatic metabolism and reduce lanreotide efficacy; affects serotonin pathways
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult oncologist or endocrinologist before use

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B12 supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Lanreotide may impair B12 absorption; supplementation may be beneficial
caution_supplements.action: Monitor B12 levels annually; supplement if deficiency develops

caution_supplements.name: Calcium and Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Lanreotide may affect fat-soluble nutrient absorption and bone metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Ensure adequate intake; monitor bone density in long-term therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay lanreotide absorption and alter GI transit time
caution_foods.action: Administer lanreotide injections independent of meal timing; consistent timing recommended

caution_foods.name: Foods high in tyramine
caution_foods.mechanism: Lanreotide inhibits GI motility; theoretical concern with vasoactive compounds
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance needed; monitor for unusual symptoms

monitoring_notes: Monitor vitamin B12, glucose, and thyroid function regularly during lanreotide therapy. Assess nutritional status as lanreotide affects fat-soluble vitamin absorption and GI function.
